senses.gloss: (v. קְרַט) to break, cut into small pieces.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1:7">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ</cite> <he>נסתון</he> … <he>וקַרְטְטָן קומוי וכ׳</he> Bar Ḳ. took them (the fruit) and cut them in his presence, saying, is this worth anything?—Part. pass. <he>מְקַרְטַט</he>, <he>מְקַרְטְטָה</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1:7">Ib.</cite> <he>עד כדון מילה מק׳ ולא טבא מילה מק׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Zyt. <he>מקרטמה</he>) so far (you are right) as to a thing which is worth nothing when cut; how about a thing which is valuable when it is cut?
